summary: Iteration 8 — Full backend + frontend verification of Daily Checklist and Workflow Order features. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases pass (test_iteration8.py) covering stage transitions (full happy path order_received→payment_received→check_schedule→client_arrived→photo_session→editing→awaiting_final→completed with final label '<client> - Paid in Full'), order enforcement (cannot skip steps -> 400), role permissions (photographer blocked from check_schedule 403, editor blocked from start_session 403), complete_order rejected without full payment, finish_session sets edit_deadline = +3 working days skipping Sunday (verified by counting weekdays between received and deadline), DP payment transitions stage from order_received to payment_received, POST /bookings/{id}/addons allowed only after editing (awaiting_final/addon) and correctly bumps price and sets stage=addon, GET /workflow returns 403 for photographer/editor and 200 for admin with full stage list, GET /attendance/late-today 403 for staff, GET /checklist/today returns 4 seeded admin tasks with Follow up klien target=10, POST /checklist/{tid}/complete rejected for target>1 (400) while /increment loops 10× auto-completes, single-target tasks complete OK, GET /reports/checklist admin-only (editor 403) returns per-staff items with notes (Great/Lalai/none), /task-templates POST+DELETE super-only (admin 403), newly created template appears in photographer's /checklist/today. Frontend: 9/9 UI scenarios pass on 390×844 mobile viewport — (1) Admin home shows home-checklist-card + home-workflow-card + Staff Terlambat section (home-late-empty rendered when no late staff), (2) /checklist as admin shows task rows with +1 and Selesai buttons, 'Laporan Checklist Harian' button visible, 'Kelola Tugas Harian' hidden for non-super, (3) /workflow shows all stage filter chips including photo_session, editing, completed plus Semua Aktif and Terlambat, (4) /checklist-report renders completed/pending metrics and per-staff cards with notes like 'Lalai: 4 tugas belum selesai…' and 'Tidak ada tugas hari ini.', (5) /more for admin shows menu-checklist / menu-workflow / menu-checklist-report / menu-attendance / menu-online-booking and HIDES menu-task-templates, (6) photographer /checklist loads (no jobs today — expected when no sessions), (7) photographer /more HIDES menu-workflow and menu-checklist-report, (8) super admin /task-templates has template-role Segmented, title/target inputs, add button, 15 existing rows; add→delete flow verified (added TEST_UI8 Rapikan studio, then deleted via template-delete→template-delete-confirm; row count returned to 15), (9) super admin /more shows menu-task-templates. Cleanup: TEST_IT8 bookings auto-cancelled via pytest session fixture (0 remaining verified). Super Admin PIN remains 123456.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing react-native-web deprecation warning carried over from iterations 5–7: shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius should migrate to boxShadow (or Platform.select) to silence console warnings on web.

action_items: No functional fixes required for this iteration — feature set is working end-to-end.
Optional: migrate deprecated RN shadow* style props → boxShadow for react-native-web to clean console warnings.

Nice-to-have: add a visible 'Mulai Sesi'/'Selesai' quick-action on the booking detail WorkflowCard for photographer role verification via UI (today the backend stage endpoint is fully covered and the WorkflowCard renders actions via workflow-action-{action} testIDs, but a photographer UI happy-path end-to-end click sequence was not run in this iteration because jobs_for depends on live confirmed bookings on today's date).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py add_working_days() correctly skips Sunday (weekday==6) only; this matches Mon–Sat working-day requirement. Verified via computed deadline minus received counting weekdays != 6.

ACTIONS table in server.py:1246 pairs each action with a 'who' and may_act() allows any user with eff_perms(booking)=True (admins / super) to perform photographer/editor steps — useful for admin recovery, aligned with existing permission model. No change needed.
/api/bookings/{bid}/stage returns 400 'Order belum lunas…' only after the role/stage check — correct order of validation.

/api/reports/checklist filter 'j[\'done\'] and j[\'done_date\'] == date or not j[\'done\'] and (j[\'due\'] or \'9999\') <= date' relies on Python precedence; the intent (completed-today OR overdue-by-today) works but a bit hard to read — consider explicit parentheses for maintainability.
task-templates DELETE is a soft delete (active=False) — matches soft-delete pattern used elsewhere.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created ~6 TEST_IT8_* confirmed bookings during pytest; all auto-cancelled via session fixture (verified 0 TEST_IT8 remaining). Frontend added one 'TEST_UI8 Rapikan studio' template under photographer role and deleted it in the same run. task_logs for today may contain increments against seeded admin templates (Follow up klien, Siapkan konten, Kirim broadcast) under Admin 1 / Admin 2 — this is normal daily data and self-expires at midnight WIB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL https://casadella-studio.preview.emergentagent.com. Env key is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Super Admin PIN 123456. Backend STAGES order: order_received→payment_received→check_schedule→client_arrived→photo_session→editing→awaiting_final→addon→completed. Stage endpoint: POST /api/bookings/{id}/stage body {action: check_schedule|client_arrived|start_session|finish_session|finish_editing|complete_order}. finish_session side-effects: sets edit_received_date=today-WIB and edit_deadline=+3 working days (skips Sunday only). complete_order requires paid_total==price (otherwise HTTP 400 'Order belum lunas…'). Payment on order_received auto-advances to payment_received. /bookings/{id}/addons only in awaiting_final/addon stages and raises price. /api/workflow and /api/reports/checklist and /api/attendance/late-today are ADMIN-only (403 for photographer/editor). task-templates POST/DELETE super-admin only. Daily seeded admin tasks: 'Input booking harian' (t=1), 'Follow up klien' (t=10), 'Siapkan konten broadcast' (t=1), 'Kirim broadcast' (t=1). testIDs: home-checklist-card, home-workflow-card, home-late-empty, home-late-{uid}, home-stage-{stage_key}, home-booking-stage-{bid}, task-{tid}, task-increment-{tid}, task-complete-{tid}, task-count-{tid}, job-{bid}, job-action-{bid}, checklist-report-button, checklist-templates-button (super only), workflow-filter-active|overdue|{stage_key}, workflow-item-{bid}, workflow-card, workflow-stage-label, workflow-step-{stage_key}, workflow-action-{action}, workflow-add-addon-button, addon-sheet, addon-name-input, addon-price-input, addon-save-button, report-completed, report-pending, report-staff-{uid}, report-note-{uid}, template-role (Segmented), template-title-input, template-target-input, template-add-button, template-{tid}, template-delete-{tid}, template-delete-confirm-{tid}, template-delete-abort-{tid}, menu-checklist/workflow/checklist-report/task-templates.
